name: Portainer
author: Netlens
description: Shows every Docker environment that a Portainer manages (local socket, Portainer agents and Edge agents) with its containers: state, health, restarts, image, compose project and published ports. One connection covers all your Docker hosts, without opening each host's Docker port. Read-only: it only lists environments, containers and networks. Kubernetes and Azure environments are skipped.

config.label: Portainer servers
config.help: In Portainer: your account (top right) → My account → Access tokens → Add access token. For a read-only view create a separate user, give it the Standard user or Read-only role on the environments, and make the token for that user.

columns.label: Portainer host's own address
columns.help: Only needed when Portainer is reached by name or as 127.0.0.1: the address of the machine whose Docker socket Portainer manages locally.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Portainer makes a self-signed certificate on port 9443; leave this off unless you installed your own.
